amends.change_summary: Replace practical-superiority / numeric-margin GO criteria with a pre-specified estimation study. Cohort, methods, endpoints, F1–F3, bootstrap B/seed, Wilcoxon, and Holm remain unchanged. Numeric practical margins are not invented; profile-level practical significance is NOT_DEFINED_AT_PROFILE_LEVEL. Operational benefit remains C4.

branding.continuity_note: Repository name may remain for continuity; manuscript framing must not imply validated adaptive or predictive functionality.
branding.working_contribution: A rigorous empirical methodology and benchmark for application-profile maintenance, refresh cadence, freshness, cost, and downstream validity.

rules.text: V3 may establish direction, magnitude, uncertainty, and statistical distinguishability for the frozen F1–F3 contrasts and endpoints.
Statistical significance alone must never imply practical or operational superiority.
Do not recommend a refresh cadence solely from p-values.

Call a method strictly Pareto-dominated only when the predefined fidelity/cost evidence satisfies dominance on all four primary fidelity endpoints (favorable directions) and primary cost (n_refresh_events), using both paired median and paired mean effects: the dominating method is nowhere worse and strictly better on at least one fidelity endpoint or cost. Otherwise report the fidelity–cost trade-off without a dominance label.
Operational/practical benefit remains claim C4 and is deferred to system-validation gates (V7–V8).
Negative, null, and small effects remain valid and publishable estimation findings.
Do not encode expected winners; comparisons remain those frozen in F1–F3.
Do not use wording such as 'materially better' or 'practically meaningful improvement' for profile endpoints unless later operational evidence (C4) supports that language.

future_gates.V5: second-corpus replication, preferably Google ClusterData 2019 if suitability remains valid
future_gates.claim_rule: Do not claim C3–C6 before their corresponding gates pass.

methods.shared_content_semantics: Identical observation-window content for Static/PW/Full-Rewrite: (t-24h,t], >=200/288 paired finite CPU+memory slots where refresh eligibility applies.

practical_significance.interpretation: V3 reports estimation quantities only. Profile-level numeric practical-benefit / acceptable-harm margins are explicitly not defined. Statistical distinguishability must never be translated into operational superiority.

rationale_why_numeric_margins_unavailabl.deferral: Operational meaningfulness must be calibrated and validated in later system-validation gates (C4 / V7–V8), not invented before V3.

external_sources.citation: Wasserstein, R. L., & Lazar, N. A. (2016). The ASA Statement on p-Values: Context, Process, and Purpose. The American Statistician, 70(2), 129–133.
external_sources.use: Scientific conclusions and policy decisions must not rest on p-value thresholds alone; effect sizes and uncertainty are required. Separates statistical distinguishability from practical/operational superiority.

external_sources.citation: Kubernetes documentation — Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (resource metrics).
external_sources.use: Operational CPU/memory utilization is defined relative to configured resource requests and controller targets; mapping offline profile-utilization error to autoscaling/SLO outcomes therefore depends on capacity, request/limit mapping, and controller policy — not a universal profile-level margin.

rationale_why_numeric_margins_unavailabl.no_universal_conversion: No validated universal conversion from profile MAE/class error to operational benefit currently exists for this study.
rationale_why_numeric_margins_unavailabl.operational_dependence: Any operational effect depends on resource capacity, request/limit mapping, controller policy, and SLO definitions.
rationale_why_numeric_margins_unavailabl.pilot_derived_margins_forbidden: Deriving margins from the 18-VM pilot effects would be outcome-driven and is forbidden.
rationale_why_numeric_margins_unavailabl.profile_error_units: Primary fidelity errors are utilization percentages / class fractions on offline profiles, not SLO or capacity outcomes.
rationale_why_numeric_margins_unavailabl.separation_from_dynapm_evidence: External sources justify methodology and systems semantics only; they are not DynAPM empirical evidence of benefit.

protocol.observation_window_semantics: (t-24h,t], >=200/288 paired finite CPU+memory slots where refresh eligibility applies

research_questions.RQ1: What are the magnitude and uncertainty of paired fidelity and cost effects of periodic observation-window maintenance (PW-12h, PW-6h, PW-3h) relative to Static?
research_questions.RQ2: What are the magnitude and uncertainty of paired fidelity and cost effects for successive cadence increments (PW-6h vs PW-12h; PW-3h vs PW-6h)?
research_questions.RQ3: What is the incremental fidelity effect of Full-Rewrite relative to PW-3h, and what is the associated incremental refresh, write, and change cost?
research_questions.RQ4: Are the estimated effects directionally and quantitatively consistent across predefined traces, resources, and volatility strata?

statistics.practical_significance_rule: Profile-level practical significance is NOT_DEFINED_AT_PROFILE_LEVEL. Do not invent numeric margins. Do not infer operational superiority from statistical significance.
